meta.name: story-deslop
meta.description: 网文去AI味。检测并清除文本中的AI写作痕迹，让文字回归自然、非模板化。触发方式：/story-deslop、/去AI味、「去AI味」「这篇太AI了」「网文去AI味」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把AI腔重的文字改写得自然顺口
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你写网文,但稿子被读者说一股AI味。
copy.tagline_en: Rewrite AI-sounding text into natural, human prose.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web fiction and readers say it sounds AI-generated.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先扫描文本里的 AI 写作痕迹（套话、工整句式、空转情绪、解释腔等），给出轻度/中度/重度分级报告；再按等级改写，只改说法不改剧情人设，并输出改前改后对照与润色后文本。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story-deslop、/去AI味 等命令，或说「这篇太AI了」一类话时触发；你也可以要求只检测、不修改。

say.text: 这篇太AI了，帮我看看问题出在哪
say.note: 只出检测报告，不动原文

say.text: /去AI味 把这一章改自然些
say.note: 按AI味等级改写，附改前改后对照

say.text: 检查下这章有没有AI味，只标注不要改
say.note: 走提醒模式，不修改也不写文件

howto.what_en: After install, Claude scans text for AI tells (stock phrases, too-neat sentences, empty emotion), rates it mild/medium/heavy, then rewrites wording only — plot and characters untouched — and returns the report with before/after diffs.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you type /story-deslop or /去AI味, or say something like "this reads too AI". You can also ask for detection only, with no edits.

say_en.text: This reads way too AI — find what's wrong.
say_en.note: Reports AI level only; no edits.

say_en.text: /去AI味 Rewrite this chapter so it sounds natural.
say_en.note: Rewrites per AI level, shows before/after.

say_en.text: Check this chapter for AI tells, mark only, don't change it.
